definition: Coordinate via changes to a shared environment that subsequent actors can sense.
preconditions: A shared artifact has interpretable local signals.
failure_modes: Conflicting writes or poisoned signals reinforce mistakes.

definition: Commit a decision after local support exceeds an explicit threshold.
preconditions: Support units and independence assumptions are defined.
failure_modes: Correlated or duplicated votes masquerade as independent support.

definition: Agents change local stay or leave choices so a collective allocation may stabilize without an appointed leader.
preconditions: Agents observe local occupancy; stability needs a specified update model.
failure_modes: Oscillation or separate clusters never reach agreement.

definition: Increase a selection weight following a specified outcome signal.
preconditions: Feedback correlates with the target utility.
failure_modes: Early luck locks in a poor option.

definition: Reduce a signal or stored influence as time passes without qualifying refresh.
preconditions: Age and refresh events can be measured.
failure_modes: Rare useful signals disappear before reuse.

definition: Persist usable state outside the lifetime of a particular acting component.
preconditions: Artifact identity and read/write semantics remain stable.
failure_modes: State survives but becomes ambiguous, stale or corrupt.

definition: Switch the operating regime when a measured pressure crosses a defined boundary.
preconditions: Pressure can be observed; switching cost is bounded.
failure_modes: Threshold noise causes chattering and thrashing.

definition: Replace capabilities and representations between distinct lifecycle stages.
preconditions: Stage boundaries and transferable state are specified.
failure_modes: Useful state or permissions are transferred incorrectly.

definition: Bound an active component lifetime; preserve only explicitly exported artifacts.
preconditions: Startup cost and artifact durability are acceptable.
failure_modes: Cold starts exceed the savings from short lifetimes.

definition: Activate a costly action only when a defined observable predicate becomes true.
preconditions: Monitoring is cheaper than the gated action.
failure_modes: Missed or spurious triggers dominate cost.

definition: Choose a successor configuration in response to environmental pressure rather than mutate the current instance in place.
preconditions: Successor choices and state migration rules are bounded.
failure_modes: A mistaken pressure estimate chooses an unsuitable generation.

definition: Change the task environment so subsequent decisions or actions become easier.
preconditions: The environment is writable within authorized limits.
failure_modes: Setup cost exceeds future reuse or damages other tasks.

definition: Choose an action to meet a forecast future target state at the arrival time.
preconditions: Prediction horizon matches action latency.
failure_modes: Forecast error makes interception worse than reactive tracking.

definition: Adjust membership or load using local resource capacity and occupancy.
preconditions: Capacity is observable and cannot be counted twice.
failure_modes: Delayed occupancy creates overload and oscillation.

definition: Share stable functionality while varying components for distinct environmental niches.
preconditions: Niche differences are predictive and interfaces are compatible.
failure_modes: Proliferating variants cost more than a general component.

definition: Decide from bounded neighborhood observations rather than assumed global state.
preconditions: Local observation is sufficiently related to the task.
failure_modes: Unobserved distant state invalidates the local decision.

definition: Allocate search to multiple actors with bounded overlap and a merge rule.
preconditions: Search results are comparable; diversity can be retained.
failure_modes: Redundant exploration costs exceed extra coverage.

definition: Separate incompatible capabilities across roles or stages with explicit interfaces.
preconditions: Role enforcement lives outside untrusted role text.
failure_modes: Informal labels leave actual permissions unchanged.

definition: Reallocate a finite connection budget by strengthening useful edges and recycling selected low-value edges.
preconditions: Edge cost and local utility can be measured without an omniscient coordinator.
failure_modes: Feedback lag prunes a route just before it becomes necessary.

definition: Retain learned state under a maintenance rule independent of recurring original activation.
preconditions: Retention has a separate finite budget and validity checks.
failure_modes: Obsolete state persists or displaces more valuable state.
known_analogues: Persistent caches; immune memory algorithms as broader neighbors

definition: Execute a bounded local action sequence with local feedback after a coarse initiation signal.
preconditions: Initiation, termination and external resource limits are explicit.
failure_modes: Local success violates a global constraint.

definition: Store viable inactive variants that consume storage but no ongoing execution budget, then reactivate on a matching opportunity.
preconditions: Reactivation and validation cost less than rebuilding often enough to justify storage.
failure_modes: Recall is stale, unnecessary or more expensive than a warm instance.
known_analogues: Cold caches; process snapshots; standby pools

definition: Tie observable rule violations to bounded costs agreed and enforced within a repeated interaction.
preconditions: Violations are observable, identities persistent and costs meaningful.
failure_modes: Retaliation, collusion or false positives undermine cooperation.
known_analogues: Repeated-game enforcement; local admission and reputation rules
